SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET AS TARGET , KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO , KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO , KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME IN ('GR','GRD') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SMT1' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT AS PLANT , PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , PO_ITEM_NO AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , PRODUCT_CODE AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , RECEIPT_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO , RECEIPT_ITEM_NO AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ , 'C' AS STATUS , CURRENCY_CODE AS CURRENCY_CODE , to_char(RECEIPT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS GR_DATE , PRODUCT_QUANTITY AS GR_QTY , UNIT_CODE AS UNIT_MEASURE , UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , to_char(DLVR_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') as DLVR_DATE , IPHA_NO , RECEIPT_LOCATION_CODE FROM V_STEPS_GR WHERE PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND PO_ITEM_NO = $G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ AND RECEIPT_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND RECEIPT_ITEM_NO = $G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$ AND PO_NO = DECODE('$G_RS.DOC_NAME$','GRD',' ',PO_NO) UNION ALL SELECT 'SMT1' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , TARGET AS PLANT , KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO , to_number(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , '.' AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO , to_number(KEY_4) AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ , 'D' AS STATUS , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS GR_DATE , 0 AS GR_QTY , '.' AS UNIT_MEASURE , 0 AS UNIT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS DLVR_DATE , '.' AS IPHA_NO , '.' AS RECEIPT_LOCATION_CODE FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GRD' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') , IF_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') , IF_FLAG = 'E' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
